title: ChatterPay
tagline: Now WhatsApp is all you need to pay with crypto - no more apps.
description:
ChatterPay makes crypto payments accessible to billions by turning WhatsApp into a secure payment gateway. Our AI-powered protocol enables anyone to generate QR codes for their business, and pay through simple text messages, eliminating technical barriers to blockchain adoption.

The interface is a WhatsApp chat where you can ask to create QR or paid to a merchant, in any language through text or audio messages
how_its_made:
This project is using the Connect with ChatterPay SDK to enable the AA features. Is deployed in Polygon Mainnet. The QR Code Management system is built using Next.js 14, with Typescript and a UI Library. 

For the message management we are using an AI powered CRM platform

For the backend I'm using the Next.js 14 API Routes
